description: This line plot illustrates the reliability scores of three different models—labeled as "3-Model Ensemble" (blue line with circle markers), "2-Model Ensemble" (red line with circle markers), and "GPT-4" (yellow line with circle markers)—as a function of cost, which is plotted on the x-axis ranging from 0 to 10 with linear scaling and labeled in units of cost. The y-axis represents the "Reliability Score," scaled linearly from 30 to 90. The plot shows that all three models exhibit a decreasing trend in reliability score as cost increases. At a cost of 0, the reliability scores are approximately 80 for the 3-Model Ensemble, 85 for the 2-Model Ensemble, and 90 for GPT-4. As cost increases to 10, the scores decline to approximately 75 for the 3-Model Ensemble, 72 for the 2-Model Ensemble, and 40 for GPT-4. The GPT-4 line shows the steepest decline, dropping from 90 to 40, while the 3-Model Ensemble and 2-Model Ensemble lines decline more gradually, remaining relatively close to each other throughout the cost range.
